correctness.rationale: The unequal-grid AB3 coefficients are obtained by exact quadratic interpolation; their two-step characteristic cubic is computed explicitly. Schur inequalities reduce to a single sharp threshold because B<=113/200, C<=1/16, A>0, A-C>0 in the candidate stable interval. A simple unit root occurs at equality; beyond it a real root exceeds one. Exact ratio geometry and a rank-one scaled matrix limit give the complete two-island phase and sharp transient asymptotic. Embedded symbolic and independent numerical tests replayed.

value.rationale: For a familiar third-order ODE method, the result gives a complete real-decay period-two stability phase diagram and two disconnected stable ratio tails, quantifies a nonattained 10% mean-step extension, and proves that this extension can coexist with unbounded one-step history sensitivity. The motif is naturally relevant to changing-step integrators and separates spectral stability from transient robustness, not a cosmetic parameter specialization.
